card.name: Inside the word therapy
card.fires_on: The piece of a word just before the ending 'apy' in 'therapy', 'chemotherapy' or 'monotherapy'. It fires on the split-off start such as 'mon', 'T', 'HER' or 'OTHER', often in all-capital label text.

modes.label: Monotherapy split
modes.description: The piece 'mon' before 'otherapy' after 'compared to' or 'used as'.
modes.example: compared to<< mon>>otherapy. In general, avoid combined use

modes.label: Capitalized therapy split
modes.description: Pieces of THERAPY or CHEMOTHERAPY in all-caps warnings.
modes.example: REACTIONS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN PATIENTS ON PENICILLIN T<<HER>>APY.

card.writes: It pushes toward word starts like immun and cancer, and away from other treatment and therapy words, since the word is already being completed.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of the word therapy when the word is split into pieces, as in monotherapy or chemotherapy.
